extracted.intended_audience: public sector organizations, commercial contractors, nonprofit organizations, colleges and universities, and researchers seeking Office of Naval Research (ONR) funding or partnerships
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for organizations and investigators on how to find ONR funding opportunities, prepare and submit contract proposals or grant applications, and manage awarded contracts or grants. Covers solicitation types, compliance topics, award administration, and ONR partnership programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand ONR's policies on conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Before you submit a proposal for an ONR award, make sure you understand ONR's policies on conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as a prerequisite step prior to proposal submission; applicants should review ONR conflict-of-interest rules and ensure compliance before applying. (Page label: 'How to Apply' — 'make sure you understand ONR's policies on conflicts of interest.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Select the correct funding opportunity mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Get information about funding opportunities with the Office of Naval Research: Broad Agency Announcements (BAA), Notices of Funding Opportunities (NOFOs) and BAA Calls; Requests for Proposals (SAM.gov); Requests for Quotes (SAM.gov); Requests for Information (SAM.gov).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and respond to the appropriate solicitation type for your work (BAA/NOFO/BAA Calls vs. RFP/RFQ/RFI). Note that RFP/RFQ/RFI actions are found on SAM.gov. Choose the mechanism that matches the scope, timing, and procurement approach of your effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Getting started with ONR proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Before submission, follow ONR's 'Getting Started' guidance to prepare applications or proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes preparatory steps recommended by ONR (the page links to 'Getting Started'). Applicants should consult that resource for steps such as identifying program offices, understanding eligibility, and aligning project scope to ONR interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit a Contract Proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and requirements for submitting a contract proposal to ONR (listed under 'Submit a Contract Proposal').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow ONR's contract submission process — typically tied to RFP/RFQ mechanisms on SAM.gov — and adhere to specified proposal formats, submission portals, and deadlines as provided in the solicitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit a Grant Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and requirements for submitting a grant application to ONR (listed under 'Submit a Grant Application').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow ONR's grant application instructions and any NOFO-specific application requirements, formats, and submission channels indicated in the notice of funding opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance and Protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure compliance with ONR-required protections and regulatory requirements (listed under 'Compliance and Protections').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must meet applicable compliance requirements (e.g., research protections, export controls, financial compliance). Consult the ONR compliance resources linked from this section for specifics relevant to proposals and awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage your contract award
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources to administer your contract award, including how to process payments (listed under 'Manage Your Contract Award').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After award, contractors must follow ONR procedures for contract administration, invoicing, reporting, and payment processing. Use the linked resources for detailed post-award obligations and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage your grant award
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources to administer your grant award, including how to process payments (listed under 'Manage Your Grant Award').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantees must adhere to ONR grant administration procedures, reporting requirements, and financial management rules; consult the linked grant management resources and the 'Grant Terms and Conditions' section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to Grant Terms and Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the 'Grant Terms and Conditions' provided by ONR for awarded grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand and comply with the specific terms, conditions, reporting obligations, and allowable costs set forth in ONR grant agreements; these govern performance, allowable expenditures, and closeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage appropriate ONR programs and partnership channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore other ONR programs and pathways to work with ONR, including Office of Small Business, SBIR/STTR, Navy ManTech, Navy Technology Transfer, Center for Naval Analysis, NRE Connect, and ONR Global TechSolutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the program or partnership channel that best fits your organization and project (e.g., small-business-focused SBIR/STTR, technology transition via Navy Technology Transfer). Use the linked program pages to learn eligibility, submission windows, and program-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career engagement with ONR
rubrics_metrics.description: Information for individuals about careers at ONR and current job opportunities (listed under 'Careers at ONR').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While not a proposal rubric, this indicates pathways for individuals to join ONR staff; follow the 'View Careers Page' link for hiring criteria and application instructions.
